## HP Product and Feature Updates

HP's enterprise portfolio includes commercial PCs, workstations, print devices, conferencing hardware, endpoint security, and lifecycle services.

## New Product Launches
- AI-enabled commercial PCs for productivity and local inference use cases
- Updated EliteBook and Z workstation families for enterprise users
- Poly meeting devices for hybrid collaboration rooms

## Major Feature Updates
- Improved endpoint security and firmware protection through HP Wolf Security
- Enhanced device lifecycle and deployment services
- Expanded managed print analytics and fleet optimization capabilities

## Platform Enhancements
HP is increasing emphasis on device-as-a-service, security, hybrid work, and print fleet economics.

## Product Deprecations
- Legacy device models are periodically retired as refresh cycles move to newer platforms

## Regulatory Updates
Review sustainability, device disposal, data wipe, and security requirements in enterprise contracts.
